notes.title: Planet S Version 1.2.4
notes.content:
Hey everyone!


Its been three full years since the Early Access release of Planet S! Thank you all for following us on this journey and for all the great feedback over the years! As this update marks an anniversary we packed more stuff into this patch than usually. We focused on some key quaility of life features and a much improved introduction and tutorial experience for new players.


Automatic Desync Recovery
We added a system that will automatically reload / synchronize the game state after a desync was detected in multiplayer matches. Recovering from a desync is pretty much as quick as loading a savegame. The recovery will trigger automatically and you also still get a savegame for when the desync happened.


Reworked Introduction
This update also introduces a new section in the main menu with new ways to learn and get into the game. It allows you to easily play or replay the tutorial but we also added links to our official Steam guides and most importantly four dedicated scenario style tutorials to introduce new players to research, trade routes, diplomacy and combat mechanics. Lucas will guide you through these scenarios.

We also thought that it would be time to revisit some of the oldest buildings in Planet S to give them a some touch ups and to adjust their detail level to the newer buildings from Tier 3 & 4.

notes.title: Planet S Version 1.2.0
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

The time has finally come! Here is the next big update for Planet S! The update will include a new end game mechanic, a creative mode, scenario support and most importantly: Support for our first DLC "Planet S - A New Horizon" which adds a story campaign to the game.

NEW Dyson swarm
You can now research a new technology called "Dyson swarm" which will unlock a new building with which you can launch Dyson probes to build a Dyson Swarm.
The Dyson swarm will not be an unlimited energy source for regular buildings but will instead grant you Warp gate capacity. More on that in the next section.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42536346/b200443ece8a61412a8bed109085e60c4c93f145.png

Every player can produce and send probes but there is a limit of 2000 probes at which point the swarm will be complete. Probes can be traded through diplomacy in multiplayer matches. 

NEW Warp gate
The Warp gate is a new building which can be unlocked by researching the corresponding technology. Each Warp gate requires a Warp gate capacity point. You get one point per 200 Dyson probes. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42536346/bb54521df089a2b150bb63569d54e92e8de46f67.png

Warp gates act as a shortcut for all your ships. Your ships will calculate the shortest path when send somewhere and they will also incorporate Warp gates if they provide a faster route to get from point A to B.
All of your Warp gates are connected to each other.

NEW Creative mode
Update 1.2.0 also adds a Creative mode to Planet S. You can load existing savegames or create new savegames and modify the system without any resource or unlock restrictions.
You can spawns ships, change item storage levels, adjust names or colony ownership and a lot more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42536346/5e6e481b612827ff09e148a315a3bc8f610b6bf7.png

Creative mode is currently only available in singleplayer.

Bots
Bots have been greatly overhauled and are now a lot more capable in almost every area but especially combat.
Here is a list of a few highlights and notable changes:

 Bots can now go down the military path instead of just science
 Easy bots are less agressive and will not declare war on their own while normal and especially hard bots are a lot more agressive
 Bots will now build attack fleets
 Bots can also build an exo spaceship and win the game
 Bots will now react to exo spaceships being launched


Modding
We expanded the modding capabilities in many areas:

 Support for custom skyboxes
 Support for custom scenarios
 Customizable sun color and size
 Building materials can be overwritten (which ones are shown left of the minimap)
 Expanded building menu override capabilities


There are a ton of additional functions (especially in regards to scenarios) which we won't cover here. We will update our modding documentation an additional guide for scenario modding in the coming weeks.

Scenarios
As mentioned in the modding section, the game now supports custom scenarios which are singleplayer "missions" with custom quests, tasks and logic. The game currently doesn't ship with any scenarios but we hope to release some free scenarios in the future. You will also be able to create and install user scenarios through the Steam Workshop.

UI
+ The sun now has a menu and is selectable. It displays information about the Dyson swarm.
+ Completly new main menu
~ Adjusted the ingame UI in several areas: Resources and garrision stats are now at the top center, research progress in the top right.
~ The building menu no longer uses number pages (I, II, III ...) and is now scrollable instead
+ The statistics menu is now accessible through a button in the top colony menu
+ Added a "Jump to spaceport" button to the colony menu which will bring you directly to the spaceport of the planet that you are currently on
~ Improved the usability of the trade route and diplomacy menu in some areas
~ The icon selector in the flag editor is now a list instead of a cycle button

Other features & Quality of life
+ A world will now select a random skybox based on its seed
+ Added a debt limit world option
+ Increased the item storage limit to 32 bit which means you can now have more than 4 billion items
+ You can now hold SHIFT while placing a farm building to automatically place farm fields at the same time
~ Bots will now automatically reenable when loading a savegame so you don't have to reenable them manually

Bug fixes
* Fixed a few translation issues
* Fixed a bug that caused trade routes to not be displayed correctly when using DX12
* Fixed atmosphere and cloud rendering on devices running Linux Mesa
* Fixed battle music playing in some weird situations
* Fixed a bug that caused solar power plants to produce power even when the collectors were ruined
* Fixed gas planets playing ocean ambient sounds
* Fixed an issue that could cause the UI to disappear
* Fixed a roman numbering issue
* Fixed "Protein powder" and "Vitamin extract" having the wrong item category

Performance
~ Improved performance in many areas
* Fixed an issue that caused random frame hitching / stuttering especially in large savegames

These are the most notable changes and fixes!
As always we would love to hear your feedback, especially in regards to the new features and of course the story campaign.

Enjoy!
Glimmerlight Games

notes.title: Planet S Modding Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We are back with good news regarding the next big update for Planet S! The Modding Update will release next week on the 31st of May. The update won't bring any new content additions but a hand full of small changes, technical upgrades and of course modding support with Steam Workshop integration! Here is a quick overview:


 Modding Support: You will be able to add your own new content to the game or easily download mods that other players created via the Steam Workshop! The following types of content will be officially supported by our modding API:
[olist]
 World types
 Planet types
 Buildings
 Spaceships
 Population types
 Resources
 Items
 "Ambient objects" (like trees, rocks...)
 Rocket types
 Technologies
 Turret types
 Tile types
 Building menu entries
[/olist]
We will also start shipping a basic editor to create things like buildings or spaceships which will also help you to easily upload your mod to the Workshop. We will also increase the limits for building types and planets per world to make room for more player content. There are still a couple of limitations by the nature of the game like polygon limitations for models but we are open to increase these in the future as needed. Oh and Workshop mods that only use the official API should also work no problem in multiplayer matches! We will release an example mod and some guidance on how to get started on release day and then go from there!
 DirectX 12: Another huge technical addition will be support for DirectX 12. After the update you will be able to choose if you want to use DX12 or Vulkan on Windows. Our hopes is that this will improve compatibility, especially with older drivers and Intel iGPUs.
 Native Linux Support: This has also been in the works for quite a while now and our plans is to have a fully native Linux port ready when the update releases. This should bring better performance and stability for anyone who is using Linux or their Steam Deck to play Planet S, no more translation layer required!
 Multiple performance and QoL improvements


Release time zones:
Central European Time (CET): 8 pm
Eastern Time (ET): 2 pm
Pacific Time (PT): 11 am

notes.title: Planet S - State of the game #14
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Welcome back to this months (belated) state of the game! We didn't really have time to write one in time at the beginning of September as we prioritized bug fixing after the Victory Update. On that note: Thanks for the great feedback and patience after the update as a lot of problems showed up really quickly. We tried our best to test as much as possible before release but a dynamic system like the bot is very hard to test. But we are happy to report (and you probably noticed that as well) that the stability is pretty much back to the level it was at before the update.

Roadmap:

The Victory Update was the last big update that we had planned for the Early Access period. The next step will then be to release the game with version 1.0.0! We already talked about this in a previous post but this will be our plan for the road to the full release:

[olist]
 We are currently working on a "bigger" patch which will release with version 0.6.7 or 0.6.8 which will bring a bunch of requested QoL improvements as well as some balancing improvements plus some additional bug fixes.
 We will then monitor the games state (bugs and other problems) and patch any issues that come up.
 Update 1.0.0 will then release as soon as we find the game to be really stable. Update 1.0.0 will not contain any new features or changes but will instead be the latest version promoted to 1.0.0 so that the release version is as stable as prossible.
[/olist]

Future:

So whats the plan after the full release?
We will continue to fix issues and bring small improvements from time to time but we will take a break from developing any big features for some time. But there will be at least one more major update in the future: The Modding / Workshop Update! We can finally start planning for proper modding support now that most systems in the game are stable. We don't have an ETA for this update yet but it will probably take some time so our guess is that it will release in spring 2024.

Current state:

Big TODOs:

 Modding support - Coming with the Workshop Update in the future
 "Large planets" world type - We are currently investigating if that technically possible or if it will cause any problems / negatively impact the game in any way
 An option to speed up the game through a world option for faster paced more competetive multiplayer rounds (The game speed itself will be the same but buildings and other stuff will work faster or consume less resources)


Quality of life:
Here is a list of QoL changes that are in the works or on our TODO list:

 Auto upgrade mode for the city center
 Double click spaceship groups to jump to the group
 Idle spaceships selection key
 Ability to save and load flag presets
 A world option to increase or decrease the amount of resources generated in if limited resources are enabled


Bugs:
As we have already mentioned before: The Victory Update had quite a few bugs but we managed to squasch most of them but not all. Here is a current list of bugs that we are working on at the moment.

 There is a rare but annoying bug that can cause items and credits to desync in multiplayer. If you have a savegame in which that happens reliably then please send it to us via Discord or to support@teamja.dev!
 Some people seem to experience a savegame loading issue but we haven't been able to reproduce it. If you have a savegame in which that happens reliably then please send it to us via Discord or to support@teamja.dev!
 Easy bots can currently crash the game if they try to colonize a gas planet
 There is another rare crash caused by bots in general that can occure during combat
 There is a rare bug that can cause a crash when entering the loading screen


Thats it for this months SotG! This might also be the last SotG for now as we want to focus on the full release! Thank you all again for the crazy journey from the beginning of the Early Access phase until now!

TeamJA

Hey everyone!

The Victory Update is here and with it it brings a bunch of new features to the game including the long requested AI opponents ("Bots")! So lets go:

NEW AI opponents:
AI opponents are called "Bots" ingame and act very similar to a normal player:

 Up to three can be added to a game
 If a normal player leaves (in multiplayer) then that player will be replaced by a bot
 Bots DO NOT cheat so they have the same money and resources available to them like any other normal player
 They will build and supply their own colonies
 They will attack you if you are unfriendly towards

Currently Bots can't win via the new science victory and they also don't interact with the colony shares system for example. We also want to add a difficulty option for each bot added. But the most important stuff like diplomacy, war and research are all already present!

NEW Victory conditions:
A victory will now properly be detected and displayed to all players.
There are two ways to win the game: Through science or with bruteforce using military stuff.
A military victory can therefore be achieved by defeating all other players and bots.
To achieve a science victory you need to research, build, prepare and escort an Exo spaceship out of the solar system. This path is only available through the science tech tree.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42536346/a034976f4f2033d0d711cec866271f3873116156.png

NEW Exo spaceship:
The Exo spaceship is a special purpose build spaceship that can't be controlled by the player.
It will spawn above the large shipyard it was build in and it will then allow you to start the preparation process and after that the expedition itself.

 The ship can't be manually controlled / moved around
 It will always be marked with a trophy icon on the minimap
 Preparations take about 2 minutes
 Every player will be notified as soon as you start the expedition and very player will se the route that the ship will take

 Every player can buy a share every 5 minutes.
 Owning a share gives you access to a proportional cut of the revenue of that colony. For example: If you own 2 shares so 50% you get 50% of the revenue that the colony generates. Revenue excludes any upkeep so the owner will always pay the entire upkeep but not receive all the revenue if the owner doesn't own all shares.
 Buying all 4 shares of a colony will allow you to purchase the ownership of the entire colony which will be treated as a takeover so all building will be ruined!

notes.title: Planet S Version 0.5.6
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

This update brings some major balancing changes based on community feedback and our own testing.

Balancing:

We wanted to make it just a little bit easier to progress through the first tier of the game by increasing the energy produced by wind parks. 
Buildings:
~ Wind park now produces more energy: Energy 20 -> 25
Technologies:
~ Efficient turbine blades (Energy bonus for wind parks): Energy bonus 25% -> 20% (Still a bonus of +5 energy per wind park)

We wanted to reduce the money gap during tier 2 and early tier 3 and make progressing through the end of tier 3 and tier 4 more fluid. Previously you had to build ~2 full production chains for clothing for example because the first one was immediately at its limit. This is no longer the case after these changes.
Residents:
~ Fruit juices and Softdrinks: Income per citizen 2 -> 3
~ Cultivated meat and Convenience food: Consumption reduced by ~37%
~ Casual wear and Suits: Consumption reduced by ~50%
~ Cocktails and Champagne: Consumption reduced by ~20%
~ Brain interfaces and Houshold robots: Consumption reduced by ~50%

Victory Update:

Science Victory:
We are still hard at work to get the Victory Update ready is month. We thought this state of the game would be a good time to share how the new victory condition that will be introduced with the Victory Update will work. The "Military Victory" is the first option to win the game and the "Science Victory" will be the second one. The military victory will be a simple domination victory which will be triggered if you are the last faction that is still alive. The science victory on the other hand is a little more complex and it consists of the following steps:
[olist]
 Research the "Exo spaceship" technology that is exclusive to the science research tree. Its the most difficult technology to get as its only available after you have researched one of the technologies from the last decision point.
 Build an Exo spaceship. You can build an Exo spaceship in the large spaceship yard after the required technology has been researched.
 Prepare an expedition. The Exo spaceship will have to prepare for its expedition which will require some time in which it is vulnerable as its already marked on the minimap for others to see.
 Start the expedition. This will cause the Exo spaceship to pick an exit location at the border of the world and to win you will have to escort it to that location. But we warned! Every other player can see the route the Exo spaceship will take to exit the system and everyone will get a notification that the expedition has started.
 Win! You won the game as soon as the Exo spaceship leaves the system (passes the world border). 
[/olist]
This victory type will allow you to win the game without having to fight. Although do keep in mind that everyone will try to stop you from starting the final expedition.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42536346/64712e1d4a7e71794af711399525db891af92d7d.png

We wanted to integrate this mechanic into the regular game so we made it into a special building that can be researched as soon as you reach T4. One or more Terraformers can then be build per planet. Each Terraformer can supply up to 6 Terraforming sites simultaneously. A Terraforming site can be placed on any tile type and in it you can select in which tile type you want to terraform the given tile into. It will then take a small amount of time after which the Terraforming site will deconstruct itself and change the tile type underneath it into the requested type. NEW Combat:
Spaceship combat:

 Spaceships can now attack other spaceships if both factions are at war with each other
 Attack by right clicking on a spaceship with a spaceship that can attack
 Spaceships will automatically attack nearby enemies when in range
 Spaceships will only automatically follow their target when the user explicity requested the attack
 Spaceships loose all their items when destroyed


Colony combat:

 Spaceships can attack buildings
 Defensive buildings will automatically attack the strongest target within range
 Defensive buildings will form a garrison when close to each other (red area indicator)
 A colony will switch into a war state as soon as one building got destroyed
 The owner of a colony cannot build / move / destroy or upgrade any buildings on that planet while the colony is in a war state
 A colony will switch back into its normal state if no spaceship has attacked a building for the last 30 seconds
 Buildings that get destroyed will become a ruin and can be repaired if the colony is no longer in the war state
 To conquer a planet, a player has to destroy all garrisons on that planet
 A garrison gets destroyed if 60% or more of the defensive buildings of that garrison get destroyed
 The colony will be taken over by the player that destroyed the most garrisons
 After a takeover of a colony all of its buildings will become a ruin aside of the spaceport which will automatically be repaired
 All items of a colony will be destroyed after a takeover


Spaceships:
+ NEW Fighter
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42536346/1ff2eb226bedac215409e55da79d67bcd73d6a1a.png

 Three turrets that shoot projectiles

 Military specific battleship
 Requires technology to be unlocked
 Can be upgraded to be extremly fast
 Cheap but very vulnerable
 Up to four turrets that shoot projectiles (depending on its orientation towards the target)

Roadmap:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42536346/3bd0696643311f749f7dae474380bda042236ecc.png

Military Update:

The Military Update will bring a couple of new game systems and features to make combat between players (and in the future AI opponents) interesting! This includes the ability to declare war, attack enemy spaceships as well as buildings but also new spaceship types, different weapon types, new items and new defensive buildings. We wont cover everything in this post as we are not done with implementing everything and of course we want to keep a few suprises for the release! So today we will focus on two things: Weapons and siege of colonies.

Weapons:

The update will introduce spaceships and buildings that can attack other spaceships/buildings. Each building/spaceship will have a set of turrets attached to them. These turrets can attack within a defined angle. As a result of that the positioning of spaceships becomes a relevant factor based on what type of spaceship you are using. There will be two different types of turrets: Missile based turrets and laser based turrets. Missile based turrets shoot projectiles in volleys and deal damage per projectile. Laser based turrets shoot a continuous beam at its target that charges up over time to increase its damage. Here is a short video that shows both of these in action:

[previewyoutube=Rpv4D4BArPY;full][/previewyoutube]

Each building / spaceship type will come fixed with one type of turrets. 

Siege:

The easiest approach for this system would have been to just require a player to destroy every building in a colony to capture it but this would come with a couple of problems. For example spamming a bunch of defensive buildings on one spot would make it nearly impossible to capture the colony and having to destroy every building would make it really tedious. Therefore the siege system in Planet S will work differently:
[olist]
 First, the attacked colony will go into a "siege state" as soon as a player attacks the colony of another player. The owner can no longer place any new buildings while the colony is in this state to prevent players from spamming down defense buildings just after a player attacks.
 Military buildings take a short amount of time to "setup"
 Military buildings will automatically be assigned to the next local garrison (this will be visualized while placing down for example a turret)
 The attacking player then will have to conquer every garrison of the colony to take it over
 To take over a garrison the player has to destroy a certain percentage of it at which point it will surrender
 Buidings will not get destroyed directly but instead switch into a "ruin" state. That way players can just upgrade the building back into its repaired and working form. This also helps quite a lot when repairing your colony after an attack as you dont have to remember what buildings are missing and where they were placed.
[/olist]

Sadly we dont have a demonstation video for that at the moment as its not quite finished yet so you will have to wait until next time!

This is just the first small overview of whats to come and we are really looking forward to your feedback on that!
We also had a multiple people suggesting to add nukes to the game and our answer to that is: Interplanetary nukes sounds quite High-Tech right?

notes.title: Planet S Version 0.3.0 - Visual & Diplomacy Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Its time for the next big update! There is a lot to cover! With this update we also focused on preparing the game for the next big update the "Military Update" by fixing a lot of bugs especially around the multiplayer part! But now let`s have a look at the changes and additions:

Visuals:
+ NEW Added atmospheres and clouds to planets! Clouds and Atmospheres can be toggled on and off separately in the advanced graphics options. Clouds will also become invisible if you get too close to them to prevent them from blocking your view onto the planet surface when building or planing your colony.
+ NEW Added particle effects to many buildings!
+ NEW Added actual residents to cities which will wander around from building to building and make your cities look a lot more alive! Higher tier city buildings will spawn more residents to make your cities look more and more densely populated
+ NEW Added actual light sources to many buildings throughout the game which will turn on at nighttime or if another planet blocks the planet the building is on
+ NEW The game will now display an icon above buildings that require your attention! Example: Farms without at least one field will display a missing fields icon and buildings which are not supplied with enough energy will display a missing energy icon
+ Buildings will now also light up if they are in shadow because of another planet that is blocking the light
~ Made some improvements to minimap rendering to improve the clarity

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42536346/d5a4faed111fc489905198b3ff03a51f74bf2022.png

NEW Diplomacy:
Added a diplomacy system which allows players to negotiate deals, treaties with and without consequences.
Currently there are 3 relation states: 
[olist]
 Peace: The default state, not a friend but also not a foe
 Trade Treaty: The next level above "Peace" which allows the two factions to trade goods between each other!
 Alliance: Currently has no real effect but with next update the two factions will share the same enemies
[/olist]
"War" will be added with the Military Update.
You can also demand or offer/gift money!
On top of that, all of these function can be combined at will so you can offer somebody a Trade Treaty in exchange for some money or you can also demand money and threaten to cancel the Alliance if with person doesn't pay!
We plan to expand this system just like the research system with the coming updates!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42536346/ccf7bedcba3bf74a2c059a6a5105449512ce1c05.png

NEW Trade:
You can now trade with colonies of other factions in multiplayer! To do that we added a new tab to the spaceport menu where you can add trade entries to buy or sell certain goods.
You can specify the price per unit you are selling or buying at as well as an item limit.
For example you can sell vegetables at 4 credits per unit as long as your colony has more than 10 vegetables in stock! That you can always keep enough goods in stock while selling the rest.
The spaceport menu now also has a tab for the recent trades history which will show you the past 20 deals that happened!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42536346/363c08c527375ef46882d57e991c40be6f33179a.png

NEW Neutral trader:
Added a neutral trader that will visit the solar system every 10 minutes to trade with everyone in the solar system! 
We thought this would be a cool addition especially for solo players so that they can also make use of the trading system!
The trader has a buget per faction that increases with the tier of the largest colony of each faction!
You can identify the trader by his special spaceship as well as his special minimap icon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42536346/b263cbb90a1c0ed67a0ded47bee8734909d7e015.png

NEW Statistics menu:
Added a statistics menu that allows you to manage the production and consumption of goods! On top of that you can manage your income and see the amount of buildings you have on a planet. You can open the menu via the button in the building info menu or via the hotkey (default is "N").

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42536346/c70746d8036311f307be9d174e7a112aeb1bfef6.png

Performance:
~ Optimized frustum culling for buildings
~ Optimized shadows. They should now perform noticably better on higher settings and look a lot better on lower settings at the same performance
~ Optimized ambient occlusion
~ Optimized god rays. They should also perform noticably better

+ Added a scroll bar to the chat window that will show up if somebody sends a long chat message that exceeds the windows width

Bug fixes:

notes.title: Planet S Version 0.2.0 - Research Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone, it's finally time for the big research update! So let's get started:

NEW Research system:
Your Tier 2 and upwards citizens will now generate research power based on their happiness. 
The type of research power is based on their orientation (developers generate science research power, mechanics generate military research power).

There are two research trees, one for each orientation.

Each research tree contains custom and shared technologies. Custom technologies are only part of their specific tree, shared technologies will be researched in both trees.

There are also decision points where you have to choose between two technologies.

In the future we plan to expand and update this system by adding, changing, replacing or removing technologies based on your feedback as well as with new content additions like the military update.

NEW Tier 3 citizens:
+ NEW Added researchers and military technicians as tier 3 citizens. You can now upgrade your developer residences to researcher residences and your mechanics residences to military technicians residences.
+ NEW Added 22 new items:
[olist]
 Limestone 
 Wood
 Cellulose
 Construction cells
 Reinforced concrete
 Nickel 
 Soy beans
 Corn
 Biopolymer 
 Laboratory instruments
 Cars
 Ground meat
 Convenience food
 Protein powder
 Vitamin extract
 Cultivated meat
 Dye stuff
 Biofibers
 Silk
 Silk fabric
 Casual wear
 Suits
[/olist]
+ NEW Added two new construction materials: Construction cells + Reinforced concrete. Construction cells are specific to science civilizations and reinforced concrete to military civilizations.
+ NEW Added multiple new buildings and production chains

Buildings:
+ Added a depot as a researchable building which increases the storage capacity by 50
+ Added a charcoal kiln as a researchable building which produces coal
+ Added a fracking tower as a researchable building which produces oil if placed on a coal deposit
+ Added an offshore wind park as a researchable building which produces energy and must be placed on an ocean tile
- Spaceports and warehouses no longer grant additional storage capacity per building (The depot is the improved replacement)

Spaceship rebalancing:
We are rebalancing the speed of both spaceships in preparation for the military update. The current speed was way to high for future combat activities.

Explorer:
~ Speed: 400 -> 170
~ Upkeep: 50 -> 40

Small cargo spaceship:
~ Speed: 400 -> 150
~ Upkeep: 100 -> 75

Balancing:
We want to make it a bit easier to reach positive income with the first tier (workers) but make it a bit harder to have a positive balance at the end of tier 2.

Tier 1:
~ Vegetable farm: Upkeep 25 -> 20
~ Wind park: Upkeep 50 -> 40

Tier 2:
~ Gym: Upkeep 100 -> 200
~ Cinema: Upkeep 100 -> 200
~ Wheat mill: Upkeep 150 -> 200
~ Industrial bakery: Upkeep 200 -> 250

Quality of Life:
~ Farm building infos menus will now longer close when canceling farm field construction
~ Changed the icon for the production time in construction costs tooltips to increase visibility
+ Added a multiplayer version mismatch error to prevent people from joining an incompatible lobby
+ Added a progress indicator for power generators that require items
+ The max speed of a spaceship is now displayed in the spaceship info menu
~ Made the blue faction color brighter
+ Construction cost tooltips now show if a building has to be placed on coast/ocean tiles or resource deposits
+ Added two tutorial steps (Achieve a positive balance + Unlock work wear)
~ The tutorial system will now skip tutorial steps if the intended order is violated
~ Disabled the building menu button when the planet is not owned by the local player
+ Added a warning when trying to deconstruct the last spaceport / warehouse of a colony
+ The enter key on the numpad can now be used as well
+ Added a construction button in the info menu of a resource to quickly build a mine on it
~ Changed the behavior to hover and select buildings
~ Adjusted the orbit height to be closer on normal maps and higher on maps with tiny planets

Bug fixes:
* Fixed controllers being able to block UI input
* Fixed a possible desync caused by non-deterministic drone movement
* Fixed tile selection when the transfer menu is open
* Fixed an issue when transferring items
* Fixed broken savegame sorting in the savegame menu
* Fixed materials of old colonies being added to new colonies
* Fixed multiple trade route issues
* Fixed several visibility issues in the UI
* Fixed notification icons having no lighting
* Fixed multiplayer timeout timer being way too high
* Fixed several lobby issues including swapping slots
* Fixed a bug causing savegames to load improperly
* Fixed spaceship routing issues
* Fixed notification sounds being played after loading

Achievements:
+ Added 6 new achievements related to research and tier 3

Music:
+ Added two new soundstracks by Rochenreiter (one new menu, one new ingame soundtrack)

Engine:
~ The game will now switch to the lowest graphics preset on first start if your system has less than 2GB of graphics memory

Have fun with all the newly added content and we are looking forward to your feedback!

If you think we missed a big QoL change you were looking for or if you have any more suggestions, please let us know in the discussion below this thread or in the discord.

Bugs:
There are still a couple of bugs on our TODO list that will get fixed in one of the next updates:


 There is a potential desync in multiplayer when building or upgrading residences (Very difficult to reproduce on our machines thats why its taking a little longer to fix but we are working on it)
 There is a potential desync when adding spaceships to a trade route too quickly
 Sounds sometimes overlap very akwardly


Localization:
We added two additional languages to the game in the last couple of weeks: Dutch and Italian. Some people have already requested additional languages. Our current system is limited to ASCII-256 characters so most eastern languages are currently not possible but we have plans to move to a bigger supported charset in the future and we will let you know when that happens. There are also a couple of languages that we could support right now but dont have anyone that could do the translation. Spanish, Portuguese and French are languages that we could support with our current charset.

Feature requests:
We have also collected a lot of feature requests that were submitted by all of you and we wont talk about all of them here because then the post would become way too long but here are some of the most highly requested ones with our option and plan for them:


 Statistics for goods and production ratios: This is definitley planned and we actually had plans for that for one of the last updates before leaving early access but we decided to pull this feature in and we hope to have a detailed statistics menu around the time we release the Diplomacy update. It will include production and consumption rates of goods for each building, planet and the entire faction and will give you a good overview of your economy
 Terraforming: Many of you have requested some form of terraforming. We actually didnt have any plans for that but we are now considering that. We currently dont have a fixed plan for it but it could be something like a building you have to research that will allow you to remove mountains from a tile or remove beaches or ocean and so on
 Combat and trading between players: Both are planned and already part of the roadmap (Diplomacy update and Military update)


Giving an overview:
We worked out a content roadmap, to give you a more graphical overview about what is coming next:

What we are currently working on:
Besides the bugs and some of the QoL features we are currently mostly working on the big Research update. Its progressing very well and we are currently finishing up the research system. After that we will gradually add in all the remaining new buildings, do balancing and testing and then prepare for release. So the update is still very likely to be ready in August and we will talk more about it as we approach its release.

And last but not least here is a little teaser of some of the stuff that will await you in the coming month:

notes.title: Planet S Version 0.1.2
notes.content:
Hi everyone! This update again includes a number of bug fixes, a couple of quality of life improvements and a basic tutorial to get you started.

NEW Tutorial:
Many of you have told us that its kinda hard to get started with the game and we agree. To help new players getting started we are adding in an introduction tutorial.

When you start the game it will now show you a dialog and ask you if you want to do the tutorial. You can also directly disable this dialog by clicking "Never" or by disabling the tutorial in the options menu.

The tutorial is designed to help you find and control your spaceship, colonize a planet and build and supply your first city.

Notifications:
+ Notifications now show you if you can dismiss them and/or if you can click them to jump to the events location
+ Notifications can now take directly to a spaceship as well as a tile on a planet (besides just taking you to the planet)
* Fixed an issue related to notifications after loading a savegame that causes some notifications to be corrupt and crash the game

UI:
+ The game now shows you an info box when its paused
+ Item slots now show you their item amount in the tooltip if you hover over the slot
~ The font color for item slots has been tweaked slightly to be a little bit more readable
~ Tweaked the layout of the menu for farming buildings to make it clearer where you can place fields
* Fixed building materials not being marked in red in case the colony doesnt have enough of a certain resource to build a spaceship
* Fixed a crash when typing unsupported characters into text fields
* Fixed colony rename dialog not showing the current name of the colony and letting you enter  empty names
* Fixed a crash related to the minimap

Multiplayer:
* Fixed some chat messages being duplicated on some clients
* Fixed clients sometimes saving multiplayer games in the wrong savegame group
* Fixed rich presence for multiplayer lobbys after a player leaves

Spaceships:
~ Increased the size of the hitbox for spaceships (they should be easier to click now)
~ Spaceship markers are wider now and stay visible for closer camera distances
* Fixed a crash related to spaceships and trade routes
* Fixed spaceships sometimes "drifting" away from planets
* Fixed an issue where spaceships were not able to interact with a spaceport after the spaceport was moved

Savegames:
* Fixed a crash related to city clusters when loading a savegame
* Fixed faction progression not being loaded corretly from savegames

Engine:
+ Improved GPU Vulkan support detection
+ Improved startup error messages
~ A couple of UI rendering performance improvements
* Fixed a spaceship culling issue resulting in all spaceships being rendered all the time
* Fixed a framebuffer glitch when starting the game / loading a world / resizing the window

[hr][/hr]

We are also aware of a couple of desyncs that sometimes happen in multiplayer and we are activley working on that.

Some people also had problems starting the game especially when using Intel integrated graphics. We are still investigating a couple of issues but many issues are happening in Intels driver so they are not our fault and we sadly cant fix them. In the meantime we have removed Intels chips from the minimum specs of the game. The best you can do right now is to get the absolulty latest driver from Intels website and hope for the best. We hope we can address some of those issues in a future update but some are just out of our hands.

Thats all the changes and additions for this update.

TeamJA
